inlines.v: REPRESS', verb transitive [Latin repressus, reprimo; re and premo, to press.] 1. To crush; to quell; to put down; to subdue; to suppress; as, to repress sedition or rebellion; to repress the first risings of discontent. 2. To check; to restrain. Such kings favor the innocent, repress the bold. REPRESS', noun The act of subduing. [Not in use.]
